criteria.requirement: Implement simplejson.stable.stable_dumps(value) and stable_bytes(value): recursively require string object keys, JSON lists/scalars and finite Decimal values; reject cycles, unsupported Python containers, NaN/Infinity including Decimal variants, and lone surrogates not representable in UTF-8. Encode sorted Unicode keys, no insignificant spaces, no ASCII escaping, BOM or trailing newline. Preserve Decimal representation and standard numeric formatting; explicitly do not claim JCS normalization. Never mutate input or change legacy encoder defaults.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
